d: Support the Risk Management Department in assessing, monitoring, and reporting credit risk across company's business lines, including fund management, portfolio management, and brokerage. The role will support counterparty assessments, private credit reviews, cash placement exposure monitoring, and future development of credit assessment practices for brokerage credit facilities, while also contributing to wider risk management work in operational risk and market risk.
q: Strong understanding of credit risk principles, financial statement analysis, and counterparty assessment.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret both financial and non-financial risk indicators.
Ability to write clear risk reports, internal credit opinions, and concise management summaries.
Strong Excel skills and ability to maintain templates, trackers, and structured analysis files.
Willingness and ability to grow across other risk areas, including operational risk and market risk.
Attention to detail, sound judgment, and responsible handling of confidential information.
Arabic and English proficiency is a must.
Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Risk Management, or a related field.
Professional certifications such as CFA, FRM, or formal credit analysis training are an advantage.

At least 1-3 years of experience in credit risk, counterparty risk, financial analysis, banking, brokerage, investment, or a related risk function. Experience in asset management or financial institutions is an advantage
r: Prepare periodic credit risk reports for the Risk Manager, including exposure summaries, limit monitoring results, key findings, and recommended actions.
Perform credit assessments on counterparties, including banks, brokers, financial institutions, and corporates used for cash placements, trading relationships, and investment activities.
Support review of private credit and similar investment opportunities by assessing financial strength, repayment capacity, concentration risk, structure, security package, and downside factors.
Maintain credit files, internal risk opinions, financial spreading, ratio analysis worksheets, monitoring trackers, and supporting documentation.
Assist in building and refining internal methodologies for counterparty review, watchlist monitoring, internal risk views, and periodic credit reporting.
Support the design of a credit assessment process for brokerage clients if Jabal introduces client credit facilities in the future.
Coordinate with portfolio management, fund management, brokerage, finance, compliance, and operations to gather information needed for credit risk assessment and reporting.
Support other departmental work as needed, including operational risk incidents, market risk monitoring, risk committee materials, stress analysis, and policy updates.
Keep abreast of market developments, regulatory expectations, and best practices relevant to credit and counterparty risk within an asset management environment.

d: We are looking for a visionary, strategic, and results-driven National Sales Director to lead our nationwide sales operations and drive sustainable business growth. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and executing national sales strategies, expanding market presence, leading regional sales teams, and achieving organizational revenue and profitability targets.

The successful candidate will work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional departments to establish sales objectives, strengthen customer relationships, identify new market opportunities, optimize sales performance, and build a high-performing national sales organization.
Develop and execute comprehensive national sales strategies aligned with organizational goals and revenue targets.
Lead, manage, and oversee nationwide sales operations and regional sales teams.
Establish annual, quarterly, and monthly sales targets, budgets, and performance objectives.
Drive revenue growth, market penetration, customer acquisition, and business expansion across all assigned regions.
Identify new business opportunities, emerging markets, and strategic partnerships.
Develop and maintain relationships with key clients, corporate accounts, distributors, and business partners.
Monitor regional sales performance and ensure achievement of established revenue and profitability targets.
Establish sales KPIs, performance benchmarks, forecasting systems, and reporting frameworks.
Analyze market trends, competitor activities, customer behavior, and industry developments.
Lead high-value negotiations, strategic client meetings, and major business development initiatives.
Develop effective sales channel strategies and strengthen distribution networks where applicable.
Collaborate with marketing, finance, operations, and customer success teams to ensure alignment of business objectives.
Review sales forecasts, budgets, pipeline performance, and revenue projections.
Identify underperforming regions and implement strategies to improve sales productivity and results.
Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain high-performing sales leaders and teams.
Establish sales policies, procedures, incentive structures, and performance management systems.
Present national sales performance, growth opportunities, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
Ensure consistent sales execution, customer satisfaction, and brand positioning across all markets.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales Management, Marketing, or a related field. An MBA or Master's degree will be an advantage.
8–12 years of progressive experience in Sales Management, Business Development, or Commercial Leadership.
Proven experience leading large-scale sales operations across multiple regions or territories.
Demonstrated track record of achieving significant revenue growth and exceeding sales targets.
Strong expertise in national sales planning, market expansion, and commercial strategy.
Extensive experience managing regional sales managers, sales executives, and key account teams.
Excellent leadership, strategic planning, and decision-making abilities.
Strong financial acumen, including sales forecasting, budgeting, and profitability management.
Exceptional negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with CRM platforms, sales analytics, and performance management systems.
Ability to translate business objectives into actionable sales strategies.
Strong understanding of market dynamics, competitive positioning, and customer acquisition strategies.
Experience managing nationwide B2B, B2C, corporate, or enterprise sales operations.
Expertise in territory management, distribution strategy, and channel development.
Knowledge of strategic account management and high-value contract negotiations.
Experience developing sales compensation, commission, and incentive programs.
Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or other CRM platforms.
Strong understanding of revenue optimization and commercial performance management.
Experience leading organizational transformation and sales process improvement initiatives.
Leadership development and career advancement opportunities.
Opportunity to shape national sales strategy and business expansion.
Direct involvement in strategic business decisions and organizational growth.
